Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: PURPOSE: Create an open Nivelacija header and allocate its document number. Creates no lines — NIV__GenerateStavke does that.

Step.name: Insert Text
Step.Text:
PARAMS (JSON): datumNivelacije ISO "YYYY-MM-DD". Effective date. Defaults to today. nacinIzmjene ZadrziMPC | ZadrziNeto | NovaMPC. Default ZadrziMPC. napomena optional free text. azurirajStandardnu 1 = on posting, also write Artikli::ProdajnaCijena_Standardna. Default 0.
RETURNS data: nivelacijaId, brojNivelacije, datumNivelacije
NUMBERING: N-NNN-YY, zero padded to three digits, allocated as max+1 within the document's own year. Lexical MAX is safe here because the serial is fixed width and the year suffix is constant within the scan. Gaps from deleted documents are not reused, which is what an auditor expects.
WHY THE ANCHOR LIVES ON THE HEADER: NacinIzmjene decides which of neto / bruto is held constant when the VAT rate changes, and every line inherits it unless it carries its own override. See NIV__Post for the arithmetic.
WHY epSQL AND NOT A LAYOUT: nothing here needs record context, so the script stays runnable from any layout. PrimaryKey is supplied explicitly, which is belt-and-braces rather than necessary: measured 2026-09-07, epSQL INSERT DOES fire auto-enter, so CreationTimestamp / CreatedBy / ModificationTimestamp / ModifiedBy populate on their own and the TSID auto-enter would have supplied a key too. Supplying it keeps the id known to the script without a read-back.

Value.Calculation: Response_AddError ( "COMPANY_NOT_FOUND" ; "Ne mogu pronaći firmu tipa DOO." ; "companyId" ; "{}" ; "" )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── Allocate the number: highest existing serial within this document's year, plus one. Two FQL traps are avoided here, both of which produced a DUPLICATE N-001-26 on 2026-09-07 before this was fixed. First, a LIKE pattern bound through a ? placeholder does not expand its wildcards — the pattern must be inlined with epSQLQuote. Second, MAX() over a text column is not reliable in this dialect; ORDER BY DESC and taking the first row is. The serial is fixed width and the year suffix is constant within the scan, so a lexical sort is a numeric sort here. ──

Value.Calculation: epSQLExecute ( "SELECT Nivelacija.BrojNivelacije" & " FROM Nivelacija" & " WHERE Nivelacija.BrojNivelacije LIKE " & epSQLQuote ( "N-%-" & $yy ) & " ORDER BY Nivelacija.BrojNivelacije DESC" ; "useSQLResult=rs_max" )
